subject: ISO 9001:2015 Certificate Scope and Validity
message: Your ISO 9001:2015 certificate from TUV SUD (Cert No: TUV-IN-ISO-4521) shows an expiry date of 14-Jan-2025. Please confirm whether this certificate has been renewed, and if so, upload the renewed certificate with current validity. Additionally, confirm that the certification scope covers supply and installation of IoT monitoring equipment.
response: We have initiated renewal of our ISO 9001:2015 certificate. The renewal application was submitted to TUV SUD on 20-Dec-2024 before the expiry date. The renewed certificate (validity: Jan 2025 to Jan 2028) is currently being processed and will be submitted within 10 working days. The scope covers Design, Development, Supply and Installation of Industrial Automation and IoT Systems.
officer_notes: Bidder has acknowledged the concern and initiated renewal. Follow up for renewed certificate before evaluation stage.

subject: MSME Purchase Preference Eligibility and Benefit Details
message: We are registered as an MSME under Udyam Registration No. UDYAM-DL-07-0012345. Could you clarify: (1) What is the exact preference percentage applicable to MSME bidders in this tender? (2) Is there a price preference cap (e.g., within 15% of L1)? (3) Will MSME bidders be exempted from EMD requirements?
response: (1) MSME preference: Price preference of up to 15% over non-MSME L1 bidder per Make in India Order 2017. (2) Price preference cap: Yes, the preference ceiling is 15% of the L1 price. (3) EMD: MSMEs are not automatically exempt from EMD in this tender as it is a GEM special procurement. Full EMD of Rs 24 Lakhs is mandatory for all bidders.
officer_notes: Standard MSME policy response. EMD exemption not applicable here.

subject: Delivery Timeline Flexibility — Phased Installation Possibility
message: The tender requires delivery within a specified period. We wish to confirm: (1) Is a phased delivery and installation schedule acceptable (e.g., 60% delivery in 60 days, 100% in 90 days)? (2) Can the installation and commissioning phase overlap with the delivery phase? (3) Are there liquidated damages beyond day 1 of delay, and what is the daily LD rate?
response: (1) Phased delivery is acceptable subject to a mutually agreed milestone schedule submitted with the bid. (2) Installation can begin after first delivery lot is received. Overlap is permissible. (3) Liquidated damages: 0.5% of contract value per week of delay, capped at 10% of total contract value.
officer_notes: Standard LD terms confirmed. Phased delivery approved in principle.

subject: OEM Authorization Entity Name Clarification
message: The OEM Authorization letter submitted identifies the authorized partner as 'ABC Technology Solutions Pvt Ltd', while your GST registration shows 'ABC Technologies Pvt Ltd'. Please provide: (1) Clarification on whether these are the same legal entity, (2) A revised or supplementary OEM authorization letter naming ABC Technologies Pvt Ltd explicitly, or (3) A certificate of name change if applicable.
officer_notes: Awaiting response. This is a HIGH severity discrepancy that could affect bid qualification.
